purpose: Pre-generated V1 artwork for the Moon Descendants faction and Invasion announcement.

usage.note: Pre-generated event artwork. The manifest is a provenance record, not a runtime asset framework. The Invasion key art is the default Telegram announcement photo; photo-send failures remain presentation-only and fall back to text.

art_direction_summary.identity: Sib chibi apple characters: apple-shaped bodies with stems and leaves, faces integrated into the apple skin, not humans in apple costumes. The frightening tone is an atmospheric treatment of this style.
art_direction_summary.mood: mature dark fantasy; regal, ancient, supernatural, mysterious, beautiful and intimidating
motifs: gothic lunar halls and ancient territory
avoid: childish or comic exaggeration of chibi proportions
cheerful or cute presentation that undermines the frightening mood
text, frames, borders, logos or watermarks

scenes.description_en: A chibi Moon Apple queen with a stem and leaf and a silver crescent crown stands in a crystalline gothic throne hall, beneath a tall window framing a crescent moon; primary faction style anchor, Sib apple rendering.
A chibi Moon Apple knight in midnight plate with crescent engravings stands before a moonlit gothic gate, holding a crescent polearm, with a distant spired city beyond.
A veiled chibi Moon Apple oracle with glowing silver eyes works in a lunar observatory, holding a moonstone astrolabe and an eclipse-lit crystal sphere.
A hooded chibi Moon Apple huntress draws a silver crescent bow with a moonstone arrow in a misty midnight forest under a crescent moon.
A masked chibi Moon Apple reaper with glowing violet eyes stands before a huge eclipse moon, holding a black-silver crescent scythe, with shadowy hooded intruders near misty lunar spires.
The chibi Moon Apple queen presides from a dark stone dais in a moonlit throne hall, flanked by the Knight with his polearm, the Oracle with her astrolabe, and the Huntress with her bow.

A monumental lunar temple of dark stone with silver arches, a crescent-carved gate, violet moonstone crystals and a reflecting pool, guarded by two veiled apple statues; a location with no main character.

A chibi Moon Apple queen with a stem and leaf stands before breached gothic gates as a beam of cold moonlight pours out under a crescent moon, while small shadowy intruders with glowing eyes approach from both sides. Sib-style chibi apple rendering.
